scripts.build: npx esbuild main.ts --bundle --outfile=bundle.js --platform=node --packages=external && npx javascript-obfuscator bundle.js --output bundle.js
scripts.release: npx esbuild main.ts --bundle --outfile=build/bundle.js --platform=node --packages=external --minify && npx javascript-obfuscator build/bundle.js --output build/bundle.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('./package.json');const d='build/v'+p.version;fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('build/bundle.js',d+'/bundle.js')"
